name: Cloud-Collar Pillow with Waves
material: glazed porcelain with incised and carved decoration
summary: This ceramic pillow in the form of a cloud—a design pattern variously referred to as ruyi, the shape of a head of an auspicious scepter—is a fine example of qingbai ware from Jiangxi province.
